#BREAKING 🚨 

#NorteFire Evacuation order for all streets off Camino Las Ramblas down to I-5 and around to the San Juan dump has been requested. The fire is impacting homes in the area of Avenida Calita, Via La Mirada, and Via De Agua in San Juan Capistrano.
